title: Data Analyst
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 13k-18k BRL/mo.


Must-Haves:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a data engineering/ analyst role
  • Experience with Python (ETL, transformations)
  • PySpark specifically (via Databricks)
  • Familiarity with pandas‑style transformations
  • Experience with SQL for database querying and management
  • Experience with Tableau
  • Strong visual storytelling
  • Ability to innovate and make dashboards genuinely usable


Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience working with Databricks

Day to day:

A client of Insight Global is looking to hire a data analyst to join their team remotely in the LATAM region. This person will be responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and deliver end to end data solutions. This person's main focus will be on enabling the business through clean data, strong analytics, and exceptional visualization. This person will not be maintaining existing pipelines, but building new ones to support the client's strategic initiatives.

Key responsibilities listed below:

  • Partner 1:1 with business stakeholders to:
  • Understand goals and initiatives
  • Define KPIs and success metrics
  • Perform end‑to‑end data work:
  • Identify and validate data sources
  • Transform data to align with business goals
  • Build net‑new ETL pipelines as needed
  • Develop dashboards and reporting in Tableau that:
  • Tell a clear story
  • Are visually polished and intuitive
  • Are suitable for senior leadership consumption
  • Create presentations and insights that support executive decision‑making
  • Operate in a project‑based environment with ownership from intake to delivery

title: Project Support Assistant
description:
Our client is a growing nationwide network of home service experts on a mission to bring world-class service to every American household with the utmost convenience. The company is committed to providing convenient, comprehensive, and ‌professional home services to families nationwide. They are guided by values of customer obsession, an execution-first approach, and an \"invent and simplify\" mentality.


We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Business Support Assistant . This role will be responsible for coordinating the schedules of the field technicians, assigning service calls, and ensuring that all customer inquiries are handled promptly and efficiently.


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Receive incoming service requests via phone, email, or online portal. 
  • Dispatch field technicians to customer locations based on scheduling and geographic considerations. 
  • Monitor technician schedules and workload to optimize efficiency and response times. Communicate with customers to provide updates on technician arrival times and service status. 
  • Coordinate with other dispatchers and supervisors to ensure smooth workflow and effective resolution of service issues. 
  • Maintain accurate records of service calls, including customer information, service details, and technician assignments. 
  • Provide support and guidance to field technicians as needed to facilitate timely completion of service calls. 
  • Handle escalated customer inquiries and complaints in a professional and courteous manner. 
  • Collaborate with other departments, such as sales and operations, to address customer needs and improve service delivery processes.


Qualifications: 

  • Education in business administration or a related field is a plus. 
  • 3+ years of previous experience in a dispatching role, experience in a service-oriented industry will be an advantage.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. 
  • Excellent organizational abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Proficiency in computer software applications, including dispatching software and Microsoft Office Suite. 
  • Flexibility to work in the PST (California) time zone.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. If you are looking for a place where your effort directly shapes company growth and your own earnings, this is it.


We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.


You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.

What you'll do

  • Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. You are closing.
  • Run structured discovery calls that uncover real pain, not surface-level answers
  • Deliver demos tailored to what you learned in discovery, not a canned deck
  • Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract
  • Keep every open opportunity engaged with timely, relevant follow-up
  • Send clear, concise follow-up emails after every call the same day
  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline records in CRM at all times
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure tight handoffs and fast response on warm leads
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets consistently
  • Feed insights back into messaging, objection handling, and playbooks


Additional Requirements

  • 3+ years of closing experience in a B2B SaaS AE role
  • A track record of consistently exceeding quota. We will ask about this specifically. If attainment has been a struggle at any point, this is not the right fit
  • Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it
  • Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks
  • Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates
  • Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about
  • Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you
  • Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touch


Mandatory Skills

Sales

English Communication


Good-to-have Skills

HubSpot

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.

  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.

title: SDR – Cloud & IA
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em um momento de investimento estratégico para expandir nossas

unidades de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Cloud. Buscamos um(a) SDR

para ser o motor inicial de nossa aceleração, atuando na linha de frente para

identificar e qualificar empresas que buscam transformar o potencial de IA e Cloud

em valor de negócio tangível.


Nesta posição, você será o primeiro ponto de contato e um consultor de confiança

inicial, responsável por despertar o interesse do mercado e demonstrar o valor

transformador de nossas soluções. Seu desafio será prospectar e desenvolver

novas oportunidades do zero (Outbound), além de colaborar na identificação de

novos projetos em nossa base de clientes atual.


Nesta Posição, Você Irá:

• Gerenciar o início do funil de vendas, focado em prospecção ativa,

mapeamento de contas e qualificação de leads para os portfólios de IA e

Cloud.

• Construir conexões iniciais de alto impacto com tomadores de decisão,

posicionando-se como um parceiro estratégico desde o primeiro contato.

• Superar consistentemente metas de geração de pipeline e agendamento

de reuniões qualificadas, mantendo uma disciplina rigorosa na gestão do

funil.

• Colaborar com Account Managers e Executivos de Contas para fomentar

novas oportunidades de IA dentro da base de clientes existente.

• Atuar como a voz do mercado internamente, trazendo insights valiosos

sobre as dores dos clientes para ajudar a moldar a evolução de nossas

ofertas.


Você Pode Ser a Pessoa Certa Se:

• Possui experiência em vendas consultivas B2B no setor de tecnologia,

com familiaridade em soluções de IA (Gen AI, agentes, automações) e/ou

Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

• Tem perfil Hunter nato: entende que a prospecção ativa e a resiliência para

transformar um grande volume de atividades em reuniões qualificadas são o

motor do sucesso.

• Acredita em processos estruturados, combinando a arte de criar

relacionamentos com a ciência do método de qualificação e disciplina diária.

• Tem fluência no ecossistema de IA Generativa: você consegue explicar o

que é um agente de IA ou um workflow de automação e articular o valor de

negócio dessas tecnologias de forma clara.

• É um excelente comunicador, capaz de construir conexões rápidas e

eficazes em diversos níveis da organização do cliente, do técnico ao C-level.


O que você encontrará na Maitha:

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Kotlin/AWS Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59460


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

title: Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)
description:
Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)

Replay API / LeetGaming.pro (Brazil-based, fully open-source core)


Role Summary

As a Backend Go Developer, you will design, build, and scale the core Go backend that powers LeetGaming.pro’s Replay API — the engine behind AI-driven game replay analysis, matchmaking, tournaments, and player performance evaluation for competitive titles (CS2, Valorant, and more). You will work directly on parsing massive volumes of replay files, storing and querying structured data, running background workers, and delivering secure, high-performance REST/RPC/WebSocket APIs that serve gamers, teams, and tournament organizers worldwide.


What Success Looks Like

  • You ship production-ready features (new game parsers, event handlers, scoring systems, or ML integrations) that are fast, reliable, and easy to maintain.
  • The platform scales smoothly as replay volume grows, with clean code, comprehensive tests, and zero-downtime deployments via Docker + Kubernetes.
  • You actively contribute to the open-source repository, improve architecture and security (including post-quantum cryptography), and help the team move from prototype to production launch.
  • Stakeholders (founders, esports partners, and players) see tangible improvements in data accuracy, query speed, and new capabilities like MMR wallets or AI talent scoring.


How This Role Fits into the Organization

Replay API is the central backend of LeetGaming.pro. Your work directly enables the entire product: every replay upload, match analysis, tournament bracket, and player insight flows through the services you build. You will collaborate closely with the small, high-impact team (currently led by the project’s main contributor) and influence the product roadmap while keeping the entire stack open-source under MIT.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, RPC endpoints, and secure WebSocket services in Go to handle replay ingestion, search, and real-time event streaming.
  • Develop and optimize replay parsers and background workers (OCR, oracle, game-discovery, etc.) that extract player actions, statistics, and events from multiple game formats.
  • Model, store, and query large-scale replay data using MongoDB with efficient indexing, aggregation pipelines, and the repository pattern.
  • Build and maintain matchmaking, tournament, MMR, and Solana wallet integration logic.
  • Integrate and expose machine-learning models that evaluate player performance and generate talent scores.
  • Ensure high availability and scalability by containerizing services with Docker and deploying on Kubernetes.
  • Write unit/integration tests, enforce code quality with golangci-lint, and participate in CI/CD pipelines that publish images to GitHub Container Registry.
  • Harden security (RID token auth, post-quantum cryptography, input validation) across all services.
  • Document APIs (OpenAPI) and contribute to architecture decisions and Jira backlog.
  • Collaborate with the open-source community by reviewing pull requests and following the project’s contributing guidelines.


Qualifications


Required

  • Strong proficiency in Go (1.16+; 1.23+ preferred) with experience building production backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL databases) and designing performant data models.
  • Solid understanding of REST, RPC, and WebSocket APIs.
  • Experience with Docker for containerization and basic Kubernetes deployment knowledge.
  • Comfortable writing tests and following clean-code practices (linting, modular architecture).


Preferred

  • Previous work with game replay parsing, binary data formats, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems, background workers, or microservices.
  • Exposure to machine-learning model integration or analytics platforms.
  • Interest or experience in esports, competitive gaming, matchmaking systems, or blockchain/Solana integrations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (not required).
  • Located in Brazil or available for overlapping hours with a Brazil-based team.


Nice-to-Have

  • Contributions to open-source Go projects.
  • Knowledge of post-quantum cryptography or advanced security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jira, or similar tools used by the team.


What We Offer

  • Direct impact on an open-source product that is shaping the future of competitive gaming analytics.
  • Work alongside a small, passionate team that values quality code and rapid iteration.
  • Flexible remote setup with Brazil-friendly hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into senior/lead roles as the platform expands.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. If you are looking for a place where your effort directly shapes company growth and your own earnings, this is it.


We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.


You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.

What you'll do

  • Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. You are closing.
  • Run structured discovery calls that uncover real pain, not surface-level answers
  • Deliver demos tailored to what you learned in discovery, not a canned deck
  • Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract
  • Keep every open opportunity engaged with timely, relevant follow-up
  • Send clear, concise follow-up emails after every call the same day
  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline records in CRM at all times
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure tight handoffs and fast response on warm leads
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets consistently
  • Feed insights back into messaging, objection handling, and playbooks


Additional Requirements

  • 3+ years of closing experience in a B2B SaaS AE role
  • A track record of consistently exceeding quota. We will ask about this specifically. If attainment has been a struggle at any point, this is not the right fit
  • Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it
  • Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks
  • Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates
  • Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about
  • Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you
  • Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touch

Sales

English Communication


Good-to-have Skills

HubSpot

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)
description:
Backend Go Developer (Replay-API)

Replay API / LeetGaming.pro (Brazil-based, fully open-source core)


Role Summary

As a Backend Go Developer, you will design, build, and scale the core Go backend that powers LeetGaming.pro’s Replay API — the engine behind AI-driven game replay analysis, matchmaking, tournaments, and player performance evaluation for competitive titles (CS2, Valorant, and more). You will work directly on parsing massive volumes of replay files, storing and querying structured data, running background workers, and delivering secure, high-performance REST/RPC/WebSocket APIs that serve gamers, teams, and tournament organizers worldwide.


What Success Looks Like

  • You ship production-ready features (new game parsers, event handlers, scoring systems, or ML integrations) that are fast, reliable, and easy to maintain.
  • The platform scales smoothly as replay volume grows, with clean code, comprehensive tests, and zero-downtime deployments via Docker + Kubernetes.
  • You actively contribute to the open-source repository, improve architecture and security (including post-quantum cryptography), and help the team move from prototype to production launch.
  • Stakeholders (founders, esports partners, and players) see tangible improvements in data accuracy, query speed, and new capabilities like MMR wallets or AI talent scoring.


How This Role Fits into the Organization

Replay API is the central backend of LeetGaming.pro. Your work directly enables the entire product: every replay upload, match analysis, tournament bracket, and player insight flows through the services you build. You will collaborate closely with the small, high-impact team (currently led by the project’s main contributor) and influence the product roadmap while keeping the entire stack open-source under MIT.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, RPC endpoints, and secure WebSocket services in Go to handle replay ingestion, search, and real-time event streaming.
  • Develop and optimize replay parsers and background workers (OCR, oracle, game-discovery, etc.) that extract player actions, statistics, and events from multiple game formats.
  • Model, store, and query large-scale replay data using MongoDB with efficient indexing, aggregation pipelines, and the repository pattern.
  • Build and maintain matchmaking, tournament, MMR, and Solana wallet integration logic.
  • Integrate and expose machine-learning models that evaluate player performance and generate talent scores.
  • Ensure high availability and scalability by containerizing services with Docker and deploying on Kubernetes.
  • Write unit/integration tests, enforce code quality with golangci-lint, and participate in CI/CD pipelines that publish images to GitHub Container Registry.
  • Harden security (RID token auth, post-quantum cryptography, input validation) across all services.
  • Document APIs (OpenAPI) and contribute to architecture decisions and Jira backlog.
  • Collaborate with the open-source community by reviewing pull requests and following the project’s contributing guidelines.


Qualifications


Required

  • Strong proficiency in Go (1.16+; 1.23+ preferred) with experience building production backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL databases) and designing performant data models.
  • Solid understanding of REST, RPC, and WebSocket APIs.
  • Experience with Docker for containerization and basic Kubernetes deployment knowledge.
  • Comfortable writing tests and following clean-code practices (linting, modular architecture).


Preferred

  • Previous work with game replay parsing, binary data formats, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems, background workers, or microservices.
  • Exposure to machine-learning model integration or analytics platforms.
  • Interest or experience in esports, competitive gaming, matchmaking systems, or blockchain/Solana integrations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (not required).
  • Located in Brazil or available for overlapping hours with a Brazil-based team.


Nice-to-Have

  • Contributions to open-source Go projects.
  • Knowledge of post-quantum cryptography or advanced security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jira, or similar tools used by the team.


What We Offer

  • Direct impact on an open-source product that is shaping the future of competitive gaming analytics.
  • Work alongside a small, passionate team that values quality code and rapid iteration.
  • Flexible remote setup with Brazil-friendly hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into senior/lead roles as the platform expands.

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation .
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk .
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).
  • Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos).

O que vai te destacar (Diferencial):

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL).
  • Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais).

title: Immigration Paralegal (PORTUGUESE SPEAKER)
description:
Company Description

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.


Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
  • Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
  • Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
  • Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
  • Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
  • Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
  • Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills

title: Estagiário(a) de Arquitetura de Interiores
description:

Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Eletricista Subtransmissão Linha Viva II
description:

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios :

title: Executivo(a) Comercial | Feira de Santana - Bahia | Liora Energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil

Nossa Proposta de Valor:

  • Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.
  • Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.
  • Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.
Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)
Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)
Health benefits: Not offered at this stage
Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis
Probation: 2 weeks
Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil
How to Apply
Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.
